levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Most questions are too vague to actually check against (for example, 'is everything fine?').

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Most questions are specific and checkable against the learner's own systems.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The monthly checklist is genuinely distinct from the weekly one rather than a shorter copy of the same questions.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The reflection claims the checklist will definitely be used every week with no acknowledgment of realistic barriers.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The reflection honestly assesses how likely real use is and names at least one barrier.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reflection also proposes a specific, plausible fix for that barrier.

lookFors: At least one checklist question was actually revised as a result of the trial run, not left unchanged.
The monthly checklist is not simply a copy of the weekly one.
No real personal details from an actual week are required or present.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
